culprit_citations.quoted_text: Fenix Intermediate, LLC | Term Loan B - 10.76 % (SOFR + 6.75 %, 1.75 % Floor) | $ | 28,468,835

findings.detail: FX02 flagged U_USD as non-USD, but the raw schedule presents fair value amounts in dollars, including the total fair value of $1,364,884,229.

rationale: The flagged field is fair_value_currency with value U_USD. Raw SOI evidence shows the fair value column is dollar-denominated: representative position rows use dollar-marked fair value columns and the schedule total explicitly reports Total Investments fair value as $1,364,884,229. The source therefore does not support a real non-USD fair-value currency defect; the issue is the FX02 check treating U_USD as not USD.
